name: Ticket tracker
description: Manage support requests, priorities, assignees, and Jira/mail/runbook integration hooks.
instructions: For the Ticket tracker template, keep ticket, message, team, and import run records app-scoped. Use Jira to load issues assigned to the current user and import selected issues into tickets. Use sorting/filtering for status, priority, assignee, source, and updated time. Use Google Mail for requester context, Confluence for runbooks, and LLM Chat for handoff summaries.
